title: Natural affine section comparison for coherent completion
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and U an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with Noetherian open subscheme. Write A = Gamma(X,U) and J = I(U). Let rho: Coh(X,I) → Coh(U,I|U) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] be a functor whose composite with the full inverse-system inclusion equals termwise open restriction. There exists a zero-preserving functor F: Coh(U,I|U) → Mod(A), reflecting limits of parallel pairs, and A-linear equivalences e_G: F(rho(completion G)) ≃ AdicCompletion J Gamma(G,U) [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] for every coherent G. For every coherent morphism f: G → H and every element x, e_H(F(rho(completion f))(x)) = AdicCompletion.map J (Gamma(f,U))(e_G(x)). No short exact sequence, finite-generation conclusion, or exactness assertion is included.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0881 (lemma-exact), affine identification in the proof, and Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine)

proof.text: Construct F as the actual ModuleCat limit of the affine section tower. Full faithfulness gives reflection of parallel-pair limits. Zero-map preservation is proved by composing with every limit projection; the tower sends zero maps componentwise to zero.
Apply the finite-level affine quotient comparison theta, including its transition and coherent-map equations.

Compose theta with mkQ. Injectivity of theta identifies the projection kernel with the ideal power, and surjectivity of theta and mkQ gives full range. Apply the existing stable-range completion/limit theorem with c=0 to obtain the canonical linear isomorphisms v_G and set e_G=v_G inverse.

Apply v_H injectivity and Concrete.limit_ext to naturality. Rewrite each limit projection using the specified equations for v_G and v_H, then the limit-map projection equation. The finite-level coherent-map equation is exactly the desired equality after applying AdicCompletion.eval. All hypotheses and conclusions of the original statement are preserved.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 087W and 0881; concrete section limits, finite-level quotient comparison, and c=0 specialization of the stable-range limit construction

lean.statement:
theorem formalCompletion_affine_natural_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (U : X.Opens) [IsNoetherian U.toScheme] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (ρ : CoherentFormalModule X I ⥤ CoherentFormalModule U.toScheme (I.comap U.ι))
    (hρ : ρ ⋙ (IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap U.ι)).ι =
      (IsCoherentFormalModule I).ι ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ X.Modules U.toScheme.Modules).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)) :
    ∃ F : CoherentFormalModule U.toScheme (I.comap U.ι) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U),
      F.PreservesZeroMorphisms ∧ ReflectsLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair F ∧
      ∃ e : ∀ G : CoherentModules X,
        F.obj (ρ.obj ((completion X I).obj G)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
          AdicCompletion (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩) Γ(G.obj, U),
        ∀ (G H : CoherentModules X) (f : G ⟶ H) (x),
          e H ((F.map (ρ.map ((completion X I).map f))) x) =
            AdicCompletion.map (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩) (f.hom.val.app (op U)).hom (e G x)
